rule_description: Scenario must have a validated assumption set; unvalidated assumptions trigger challenge
Any hard limit violation in assumption validation invalidates the scenario
Baseline status must be Available or Available with Conditions; Blocked baselines fail validation
Baseline data completeness must meet minimum threshold
Baseline must be derived from at least one observation
Scenario value must reconcile with baseline + absolute_change within tolerance
Percentage change must reconcile with (scenario - baseline) / baseline * 100 within tolerance
Conservative/Expected/Higher Intensity comparators must have distinct assumption values
Scenario values across comparators must show non-zero spread
Dominance claim requires non-identical comparator outcomes
Sensitivity classification requires stable direction across comparators
Diminishing returns requires detectable incremental effect variation
Risk displacement records must include evidence basis
Management interpretation must not contain forbidden speculative phrases
Final scenario confidence must not exceed Moderate without confirmed causality
Any scenario with causality_status = Not Confirmed must be flagged
High contradiction severity requires management review
Provisional warnings must be tracked and resolved before final approval
Non-comparable scenarios must have documented exclusion reason
Every comparable scenario must have at least one evidence record
